lede: One person, one lead agent, and a small cell of sub-agents and outside models set up for this one film and taken down when it is done.
note: Models as recorded on 28 November 2026. The lead's model is read from its own session record. Sub-agents started by the lead take the lead's model unless another is set, and none was set; that was not checked run by run. Outside models are named as the service reported them.

tree.name: Dinis Cruz
tree.does: Gives the brief, watches each version, says what is wrong, and is the only one who can approve it for publishing.

members.name: c.productions
members.does: Writes the storyboard and each brief, looks at every frame, joins the scenes into versions, runs the site's checks, signs and pushes. A successor session since the hand-over of 28 November.

members.name: Scene-smiths (five at once)
members.does: One per scene: build a WebGL scene, shoot its own frames, criticise them against the rubric, improve. They cannot push or publish.
members.model: The lead's model (Claude Fable 5.2), not set separately
members.runs: 10 runs in two rounds: the scroll and the curve, the 300,000 line, the shelf, the keys and the test, the saving.

members.name: Critic
members.does: Scores a version against the rubric from its frames and names the changes that would help most. Never rewrites.
members.model: The lead's model (Claude Fable 5.2), not set separately

members.name: Outside critic
members.does: A second opinion from a different maker's model, shown contact sheets of the frames and the narration.

members.name: Synthetic test viewers (five)
members.does: Invented viewers, each asked whether they would stop scrolling, where they would leave, and what they would do tomorrow.

members.name: Voice
members.does: Speaks the narration. One stock preset voice, labelled on screen as made by AI.

members.name: The first c.productions session
members.does: Built the pipeline, wrote the one-page document and this film's brief, then wrote its hand-over notes and stopped. The film is about what it did.

members.name: accountant.c, conductor.c, c.maestro
members.does: Not part of the cell: the accountant measured the sessions before and after, the conductor started the successor, the maestro holds the sealed vault keys.

flow: The owner gives a brief and a document of facts.
The lead writes a storyboard: every beat with a sketch, its words and its numbers.
Five scene-smiths build the five scenes at the same time and judge their own frames.
The lead looks at every frame, joins the scenes with a voice, and publishes the version for review.
Critics and synthetic viewers judge it; the lead chooses what to change.
Each scene-smith does one more round; a new version is cut.
The owner watches and speaks his feedback; the loop runs again.
When the film is signed, the cell is taken down. Its files stay.
